description: Use this when someone wants to browse the fact database: what Rockstar and Take-Two have confirmed about GTA 6 and what named people have said on the record, rather than a ruling on one claim (use check_claim for that). Returns every matching claim with its status (confirmed or reported), why, when it was last checked and its source. Optional filters: status, or a keyword.

limit.description: How many facts to return, 1 to 50 (default 25)

query.description: Keywords every returned fact must contain in its claim or reason, for example "PC" or "open world"

status.description: Only facts with this status. Leave out to include every status.

name: get_facts
title: GTA 6 facts with their status
